text:
ellie: quick heads-up — ACME wants a marketplace listing the week of May 15. They asked for SOC2, latest pen-test, and answers to the vendor questionnaire. Also a joint press stmt with embargo. who can own the compliance bundle + press cadence?
ben: i can own the SOC2 + pen-test artifacts. need to confirm pen-test window (must be within 90 days) and whether the vendor will allow witness.
nina: for the SI integration, we need temporary creds and an auth-scoped IAM role. can ACME provision a read-only service account? CC @ellie
tom: legal: embargo date needs to be exact. we should avoid any pre-release screenshots in the listing. send me proposed press copy 72h before embargo.
ellie: ACME asked for a presign flow for artifacts. ben — can you do presigned S3 links with 7-day TTL? marketplace-bot: created ticket INTAKE-4921 for ACME marketplace listing (owner: partnerships).
ben: 7-day TTL ok for initial ingest, but for the pen-test PDF we need a signed attestation too. i'll redact IPs and list contact points. owner: ben.
nina: i'll take the SI checklist: integration playbook, contact list, test plan, and a staging endpoint. ETA Friday.
tom: confirm: embargo lift = release time + 15 minutes buffer? propose lift at 10:00 PT on the target date. also need the press distro list.
ellie: thanks. action items: ben = SOC2 + pen redaction + presign, nina = SI checklist + creds, tom = embargo wording + distro. i'll own announcement timing and partner comms. please add items to INTAKE-4921.
ben: quick note — if ACME will not allow witness, we can get an external attestation from the assessor and timestamp it. need the assessor name.
ellie: ACME's security lead said assessor is 'RedGate Sec'. i'll ping them.
marketplace-bot: reminder: marketplace listing requires at least one artifact uploaded to the listing bucket 48h before approval window.
nina: thanks bot. i'll queue the staging creds request today.
tom: will draft embargo clause and share in thread.
ellie: 👍 can everyone confirm their ETA in the ticket by EOD? we need to lock press copy by Tue. :thumbsup:
